verdict.rationale: Rive is a collaborative design and animation editor, so in-file commenting, mentions and thread resolution are a fair axis. The evidence only shows simultaneous multi-person editing tracked in Revision History. That is an adjacent capability, not commenting, @-mentions or resolvable review threads.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email
